PUID.description: User ID for file ownership inside the container.

PGID.description: Group ID for file ownership inside the container.

STGUIADDRESS.description: Address and port for the web GUI. Must bind to 0.0.0.0 to be accessible outside the container.

setup-info.content: On first visit, you'll see a 'GUI Authentication Required' warning. Go to **Actions > Settings > GUI** to set a username and password.
